description: MONTHS_BETWEEN uses Snowflake's formula (y1-y2)*12 + (m1-m2) + (day1-day2)/31, with a whole-number result when the day numbers match or both dates are their month's last day. The previous implementation double-counted the day difference - adding a day fraction on top of a Period that already accounted for it - so a partial-month case returned the wrong magnitude. The result carries Snowflake's NUMBER(27,6) scale, so the 31-day fraction is rounded to six decimals and never a raw double; the converted suite stringifies the result so those trailing digits are part of the assertion. Arguments must be temporal: VARCHAR inputs, literals included, are rejected at compile time, so every date is cast ::DATE. Converted 1:1 from functions/MonthsBetweenTest (now retired).
